title: Agent-hour fields, rendering, totals and calibration
goal: Steps can be estimated and recorded in agent hours with owner time apart
acceptance: agentHours, ownerHours, baselineAgentHours, actualAgentHours in quarter hours; one actual unit per step; closed steps have no remaining hours
Table cells and totals show hours, never adding hours and days
Calibration pairs actual and baseline in the same unit
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Released in v5.6.0 after PR #123 (CI) and review-fix PR #124 (CI 43080122901) with independent review; baseline 1.5 agent hours. Actual stated from PR and release timestamps: work began about 18:15 UTC while PR #120 was in review and 5.6.0 was released at 18:44, interleaved with other fixes; 0.5 h covers F-058-T01 and F-058-T02 together.
